private_lines.Kenta: You live in Kita-ku, Osaka, in a small apartment you have had for three years, and you work as a maintenance technician for a railway company. This week you are on a day shift, with a signalling inspection on Thursday, and you are looking forward to a quiet weekend.
private_lines.Aoi: You live in Tennoji, Osaka, and work as a pharmacist at a hospital dispensary, with rotating shifts. This week you have three early starts and a long Thursday, and you are trying to find time for your own errands on the weekend.

setting: You are both living in Osaka, in the Kansai region of Japan. You matched on a dating app last week and have been texting since, but you have not met in person yet. You each know roughly what the other does for work and which neighbourhood they live in. Last time you talked, you were trading complaints about a train delay on the Midosuji line that morning.
